customManagers.description: Upstream tag + pinned commit in images/*/image.yaml (ADR-003)
Parameterised UBI base in Containerfiles (ADR-004): pin and refresh tag@digest
customManagers.autoReplaceStringTemplate:
# renovate: datasource={{{datasource}}} depName={{{depName}}}
ARG BASE_TAG={{{newValue}}}{{#if newDigest}}@{{{newDigest}}}{{/if}}

customManagers.description: Build-stage Go toolchain in Containerfiles (ADR-004): tag@digest, reviewed by a human
customManagers.autoReplaceStringTemplate:
# renovate: datasource={{{datasource}}} depName={{{depName}}}
ARG GO_TAG={{{newValue}}}{{#if newDigest}}@{{{newDigest}}}{{/if}}

packageRules.description: Pin digests for the regex-managed UBI base
UBI base digest refreshes: automerge after green CI (only route for OS CVE fixes, ADR-003 §5)
Toolchain bumps are never automerged: a new Go can change the binary (ADR-004)
Upstream bumps need a human: check go.mod Go version, licence, NOTICE changes
